name: @intelligent-farming/mock-sensors
description: Mock LoRaWAN ag sensors that inject valid uplinks into the intelligent-farming-stack bench, for demos and end-to-end tests.

scripts.stack:up: npm run pack-codec && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --profile mock up -d --build chirpstack-postgres redis mosquitto events-postgres chirpstack chirpstack-rest-api chirpstack-gateway-bridge events-api mock-sensors
scripts.mock:up: npm run pack-codec && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --profile mock up -d --build mock-sensors
scripts.watch:db: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec events-postgres psql -U events -d chirpstack_events -c 'select time, dev_eui, f_port, object from event_up order by time desc limit 20;'
scripts.watch:db:count: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec events-postgres psql -U events -d chirpstack_events -c 'select count(*) as event_up_rows from event_up;'
scripts.watch:graphql: curl -s http://localhost:5050/graphql -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query":"{ allEventUps(orderBy: TIME_DESC, first: 10){ nodes { devEui deviceName fPort object } } }"}'
